summary: Fort Technology Inc., a Toronto-based foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq (FRTT) and TSXV (FORT), furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated October 20, 2026, announcing that majority-owned subsidiary Logia USA Inc. signed an exclusive Commercial Distributorship Agreement with Schwab Vollhaber Lubratt, Inc. (SVL), a Roseville, Minnesota HVAC representative. SVL gains exclusive purchase and resale rights for Logia's automated fuel maintenance systems across North Dakota, Minnesota, Wisconsin, Iowa, Michigan's Upper Peninsula and several Illinois counties, effective October 12, 2026 through July 31, 2027. This is an ordinary commercial distribution contract, not a special situation; watch commercialization progress and termination risk.
